personality_one_liner: A cinematic, elegant, and classic bookstore experience draped in midnight charcoal and antique gold, where every book feels like a rare discovery.

spacing.rule: Generous, cinematic margins. Content should never feel cramped. Use padding to give focus to cover art.

do's: Use heavy glass effect for bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Apply glass blur over hero image background to make text readable.
Use frosted glass panels for floating action buttons or bottom sheet drag handles.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body content regions or form fields.
Do not make lists fully glass—keep them solid surfaceSecondary for readability.

screens.name: Home Feed
screens.purpose: A cinematic discovery experience spotlighting hero books, categories, best sellers, and new arrivals.

states.loading: Skeleton placeholders mimicking book covers and header blocks.
states.empty: N/A - Home should always display curated content.
states.error: Elegant text centered: 'The archives are currently closed.' + Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero Banner at the top featuring a full-width image with a vertical dark gradient scrim and a featured book. Horizontal scroll rows below for 'Best Sellers', 'New Arrivals', and 'Trending', separated by elegant typography headers. Category chips row. All books displayed as elegant portrait cards with metadata.

screens.name: Books Listing
screens.purpose: A highly functional yet premium catalog view for browsing books with search, filters, and sort options.

states.loading: Grid of shimmering book cover skeletons.
states.empty: Illustration of a solitary antique bookshelf with text 'No tomes found for your search.'
states.error: Error message with a 'Refresh Catalog' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glassmorphic search bar and filter/sort row at the top. Below is a 2-column grid of books. Each card showcases the cover art elegantly framed. Category chip row below the search for quick filtering.

screens.name: Book Details
screens.purpose: A deep dive into a book's world, featuring immersive cover presentation, rich metadata, reviews, and related titles.

states.loading: Spinner over a blurred placeholder cover.
states.error: Error message with 'Return to Catalog' button.

screens.layout: Immersive hero section: blurred background image of the cover art with the crisp book cover centered on top. Generous whitespace around the title (Serif) and author. Sectioned content below: Synopsis, Details (Pages, Publisher), Reviews (styled elegantly with stars), and horizontal 'Related Books' scroll. Sticky 'Add to Cart / Buy Now' primary CTA at the bottom in a frosted glass container.

screens.name: Shopping Cart
screens.purpose: A clean, trustworthy checkout staging area to review items and apply coupons.

states.empty: Empty cart icon/illustration with 'Your cart is as empty as an unwritten page.' and a 'Browse Books' primary CTA.

screens.layout: List of items with small cover thumbnails, title, price, and quantity steppers. A coupon input field below the list. Sticky bottom sheet showing subtotal, tax, and a bold 'Proceed to Checkout' button.

screens.name: Wishlist
screens.purpose: A personal archive of desired books.

states.empty: Illustration of a closed leather journal with 'Your wishlist is currently empty.'

screens.layout: Simple 2-column grid or list view mirroring the Books Listing, but with easy 'Remove' actions and 'Move to Cart' buttons.

screens.name: Auth (Login/Signup)
screens.purpose: The elegant gateway into the user's personal account.

states.loading: Button disabled with small inline spinner.
states.error: Inline elegant red warning text below the input field.

screens.layout: Cinematic full-screen background image of a dark library with a heavy gradient scrim. White/Gold text on top. Clean, single-column input fields (surfaceTertiary background, no heavy borders). Bottom-anchored primary action button.

screens.name: Checkout (Multi-step)
screens.purpose: A seamless, reassuring flow to finalize the purchase across Address, Summary, Payment, and Confirmation.

states.error: Clear error message if payment fails.

screens.layout: Progress indicator at the top (e.g., 1. Address, 2. Summary, 3. Payment). Form inputs for addresses. A clean summary sheet. A mocked payment entry using elegant, secure-looking inputs. Final confirmation screen featuring a success checkmark and the order number.

screens.name: Order Tracking Timeline
screens.purpose: A beautiful, step-by-step visual representation of the order's journey.
screens.layout: Vertical timeline with elegant gold nodes for completed steps and muted nodes for future steps (e.g., Order Placed -> Processing -> Shipped -> Delivered). Book thumbnail at the top.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: The user's central hub for settings, past orders, and addresses.
screens.layout: Header with user's initial avatar in a gold-tinted circle if no photo. List of navigation rows (Orders, Addresses, Reviews, Settings, Admin Panel) each featuring a leading icon inside a tinted surface block and a trailing chevron.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level analytics and management entry point for store owners.
screens.layout: Grid of summary stat cards (Revenue, Orders, Books) using surfaceSecondary blocks. Simple bar or line charts (if using a chart lib) or mocked data lists. Links to Book Management and Order Management.

screens.name: Admin Book / Order Management
screens.purpose: Functional interfaces for adding/editing catalog items and updating order statuses.
screens.layout: List view of books/orders with quick action menus (edit/delete/update status). Adding a book uses a clean, single-column form with image upload placeholder.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 6 Glass / Luxe personality. The design must feel high-end, cinematic, and polished. Do NOT use standard Material or standard iOS blank layouts.

Colors: The app relies heavily on stark contrasts between black/charcoal backgrounds and white/gold accents in dark mode, and ivory backgrounds with black/gold in light mode. Do not introduce stray colors like blue or purple.

Typography: Always use Cormorant Garamond (or similar elegant serif) for all headings, hero titles, and book titles. Use Geist (or clean sans-serif) for body text, author names, prices, and labels. Do not use heavy font weights (>500). Size dictates hierarchy.
Images & Scrims: ANY image used as a background (hero section, auth screen) MUST have a vertical gradient scrim overlay to guarantee text readability on top. Never render text directly on raw images.
Glassmorphism: Use blur/glass effects heavily for the bottom tab bar, sticky headers over scrolling content, floating buttons, and the backdrop of the Book Details hero image.
Layout Rules: Ensure generous padding (lg/xl). Books should be displayed in elegant portrait aspect ratios, not cropped into squares. Content rows should feel breathable.
Sticky Actions: For Book Details (Add to Cart) and Checkout (Confirm), ensure the primary CTA is locked at the bottom of the screen (in a frosted glass container) and does not scroll away.
Tabs: Implement only 4 main tabs as requested: Home, Books, Cart, Profile. Use Feather icons.
